title.en: AN ACT APPROPRIATING ONE HUNDRED DOLLARS, IN THE MONEY OF THE UNITED STATES, FOR THE PURPOSE OF PAYING THE SALARY OF THE PROPERTY CLERK IN THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION FOR THE PERIOD OF ONE MONTH FROM SEPTEMBER EIGHTH TO OCTOBER EIGHTH, NINETEEN HUNDRED.

text.en:
The sum of one hundred dollars, in the money of the United States, is hereby appropriated out of
any funds in the Insular Treasury, not otherwise appropriated, for the purpose of paying the salary of the
property clerk in the Department of Education, for the period of one month from September eighth to
October eighth, nineteen hundred.

The Military Governor is authorized to draw his warrant in favor of the duly appointed property

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, September 12, 1900.
